quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SZSE Interactive Easy: to improve optical-interconnect delivery assurance after the H1 key-material shortages, in Q2 it completed a series of measures - introduction of automation basically completed, quality-management improvements and process improvements for high-end products, fast-advancing introduction of domestic DSPs, and locking in key materials, especially overseas high-end DSP chips.
